statsPeriod: whole data range of the site files, any Sun / Earth > horizon + 0.5°

generatedWith.provenance: Pipeline code written with AI assistance (Claude Code). The values are not AI-generated: they are computed deterministically from NASA LRO LOLA terrain and JPL DE421 / NAIF ephemerides (Skyfield) and validated against JPL Horizons and the NASA LOLA illumination maps.
